title: Zener shunt regulator
goal: A reader must be able to identify reverse protection, series current limiting, and the zener shunt regulating a grounded load.

rubric.must: A source labelled 15 V unregulated is visible at the input.
An SS14 Schottky diode is visibly in series with the input.
A 330 Ω 1 W series resistor visibly feeds the regulated output node.
A 5.1 V zener diode visibly connects from the output node to ground.
A 1 kΩ load resistor is visibly connected from output to ground.
A 47 µF output capacitor is visible across the load.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. Reverse-protection diode then the series resistor, with the zener shunting to the return, its cathode to the positive rail, and the load and output capacitor across the regulated node.
